message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Official)** *Uno* is a fast‑paced card game for 2–10 players. The goal is to be the first player to score 500 points, which you earn by being the first to play all of your cards in each round and by collecting points from the cards left in opponents’ hands. --- ### 1. Deck | Card | Description | |------|-------------| | **Number cards** (0–9) | Four colors (Red, Green, Blue, Yellow). Each color has one 0 and two of each 1–9. | | **Action cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. | | **Total** | 108 cards (24 of each color + 8 Wild + 8 Wild Draw Four). | --- ### 2. Setup 1. **Shuffle** the deck thoroughly. 2. **Deal** 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the *draw pile*. 4. Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the *discard pile*. * If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Skip, the first player is skipped). 5. The player to the dealer’s left starts the game. --- ### 3. Gameplay Play proceeds clockwise (or counter‑clockwise if a Reverse is played). On a player’s turn: 1. **Match** a card from your hand to the top card of the discard pile by either: * Same color, or * Same number/symbol, or * A Wild card (any color). 2. **Play** the chosen card onto the discard pile. * If you play a Wild or Wild Draw Four, announce the new color. 3. **If you cannot play** a card, you must **draw one card** from the draw pile. * If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately. * If not, your turn ends. --- ### 4. Action Cards | Card | Effect | |------|--------| | **Skip** | Next player loses their turn. | | **Reverse** | Changes play direction. | | **Draw Two** | Next player draws two cards and loses their turn. | | **Wild** | Player chooses the next color. | | **Wild Draw Four** | Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | > **Note:** A Wild Draw Four can only be played if the player has no other playable card. If challenged and found to have a playable card, the challenger draws six cards instead of four. (This rule is optional in casual play.) --- ### 5. Going “Uno” When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. * Failure to say “UNO” before the next player draws a card results in a penalty: you must draw two cards. --- ### 6. Winning a Round A round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands: | Card | Points | |------|--------| | Number cards | Face value (0–9) | | Skip, Reverse, Draw Two | 20 | | Wild, Wild Draw Four | 50 | The round winner adds those points to their total score. Play continues until a player reaches **500 points** (or another agreed threshold). --- ### 7. Variations & House Rules - **Stacking**: Some groups allow stacking of Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards (e.g., a Draw Two can be answered with another Draw Two, adding up). - **No Wild Draw Four Challenge**: Many casual games skip the challenge rule. - **Custom Decks**: Uno can be played with themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack, Uno Spin) that add extra mechanics. --- ### 8. Quick Summary 1. Shuffle, deal 7 cards each, set up draw and discard piles. 2. Match color/number or play a Wild. 3. Use action cards to affect play. 4. Say “UNO” when down to one card. 5. First to discard all cards wins the round; score points. 6. First to 500 points wins the game. Enjoy playing Uno!
